title: LaNi(1−x)FexO3 perovskite catalysts prepared by high-energy ball milling for efficient air cathodes in alkaline fuel cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1879-1887
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06763D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chontira Sangsubun, Chakkrapong Chaiburi, Supandee Maneelok
The LaNi(1−x)FexO3 (x = 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1) perovskite powder was prepared using a conventional mixed-oxide method through high-energy ball milling and calcination at 800 °C.
